newsitem.headline: EP BUDGET COMMITTEE AGENDA - OCT 21.

text.p: Committee on Budgets [[ Monday 21 October 1996 ]] 1. Adoption of draft agenda 2. Chairman's announcements ===] 1997 BUDGET 3.1 IN CAMERA, 7 - 8.30 p.m.: Preparation of strategy for the first reading - The President and the political group chairmen have been been - invited for this discussion 3.2 1997 budget - Section III (T04556) BUD0074 SEC(96)1677 C4-0515/96 + BUDG Fond R BRINKHORST Laurens J (ELD) (PE219.043 ) - Adoption of budget amendments - Adoption of motion for a resolution 3.3 1997 budget - other sections (T04557) BUD0075 COM(96)0300 C4-0350/96 + BUDG Fond R FABRA VALLES J. (PPE) (PE218.325 ) - Adoption of amendments 4. Date of next meeting (PE/III/OJ/96-24 ) - - Deadline for presenting texts for translation: - Meeting in Brussels on 28 October: texts should be available by the evening of 16 October. - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
